name: Explore and filter local marketplace listings
description: Verifies visitors can search, filter, and open a local listing without signing in.
expected: The matching local listing appears and its detail view shows the title, price, description and location.

name: Sign in and publish a community update
description: Verifies an authenticated member can publish a community update and see it in the feed.
steps: Sign in using the secure sign-in dialog
expected: The new update is visible in the community feed after refresh.

name: Publish a marketplace listing with validation
description: Verifies empty listing details are rejected and valid listing data is published.
steps: Submit the form with title and description empty
Fill in title and description and publish
expected: The empty submission is blocked, and the valid listing appears in the marketplace.

name: Explore seeded groups and protect member actions
description: Verifies community groups are available to browse and member-only actions ask visitors to sign in.
steps: Confirm the Calabar Food Lovers group is visible
Choose a member-only action such as Join group
expected: The groups are visible publicly, and the user is asked to sign in before a restricted action.
